card.name: Time nouns after the, this, first
card.fires_on: The nouns time, day, night or times right after a determiner such as the, this, any, or first. The phrase is usually followed by a clause or 'of' that pins down a specific occasion.

modes.label: Occasion with time

modes.label: Day or night of an event
modes.description: The word day or night after the, followed by 'of' or 'before' an event.
modes.example: administer a 15 mg/kg dose as a 60-minute infusion on the<< day>> before transplantation

card.writes: It promotes words that continue a time phrase, such as ' spent' and 'bill', plus some Chinese noun-phrase endings; the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on 'time', 'day' or 'night' after 'the' or 'this' when the text is pointing to one particular occasion.
